sets.displayTitle: Aarti Dhara · Non Stop Aarti & Garba
sets.notes: Ishtar Gujarati published this Non Stop Aarti & Garba devotional set on 2021-01-05. The source credits singers Raghuvir Kunchala, Vatsala Patil, Sanjay Oza and Meena Patel; music by Shambhu Mehta; and traditional lyrics credited to Udyan Trivedi. Its description lists Aartis and Stutis including Jai Aadhya Shakti, Vishambhari Stuti and Anand Mangal Karu Aarti, without timestamps. Checked 2026-10-02: YouTube reported 3298 seconds, playabilityStatus OK and playableInEmbed true; the privacy-enhanced embed returned HTTP 200. Play the complete video from 0 through 3298 seconds. sets.notes: Soor Mandir published the Aarti Mangal full-audio jukebox on 2020-01-07. The description credits singers Uday Mazmudar, Aashit Desai, Ravindra Sathe and Rekha Trivedi; music by Uday Mazumdar; and Soor Mandir as label. The listed collection includes Jay Aadhya Shakti, Vishvambhari Stuti, Jay Khodiyar Mata, Jay Rannadevi and Anand Mangal Karu Aarti, without timestamps.
